name: Stag Lord's Bauble
summary: The Stag Lord’s Bauble is a green-lit crystal taken from a weathered stag statue at the bottom of a lake. Someone at Bloodvenom Post may know its history.

sections.title: The Lake Statue
sections.body: A stag statue lies at the bottom of a lake, worn by a pool of foul slime. You cannot tell how it came to rest there. A crystal set in a medallion around its neck gives off a sickly green light, and someone at Bloodvenom Post may know the monument’s history.

sections.title: A Fel Gleam
sections.body: At Bloodvenom Post, the gem draws an answer from the one who examines it. It has taken in some of the fel power carried by the cursed waters flowing into Felwood. More study may draw something from it, and the crystal may have power of its own if it belonged to a sacred artifact from before the war.

faq.q: Where does the Stag Lord’s Bauble come from?
faq.answer: The crystal sits in a medallion around the neck of a stag statue at the bottom of a lake.

faq.q: Why is the stag statue worn away?
faq.answer: A pool of fetid slime has eroded the statue.

faq.q: What does the bauble look like?
faq.answer: It is a single crystal set in a medallion, with an unwholesome green gleam.

faq.q: Who might know about the monument?
faq.answer: Someone at Bloodvenom Post may know the monument’s history.
The gem has absorbed some of the fel power in the cursed waters flowing into Felwood.

faq.q: Could the gem have power of its own?
faq.answer: The examiner thinks it may have power of its own if it came from a sacred artifact that predated the war.

attribution: In-game quest text: Stag Lord's Bauble
